content.short: Aftermath Finance is an all-in-one DeFi hub on Sui providing a CEX-like experience with smart order routing.
content.description: Aftermath Finance is an all-in-one DeFi hub on the Sui blockchain, offering a professional trading experience with the transparency of on-chain finance. It features a DEX aggregator with smart order routing that finds the best prices across the ecosystem with zero platform fees. Its multi-asset AMM supports liquidity pools with up to 12 assets, allowing for diverse portfolio management. The platform also provides liquid staking through afSUI, enabling users to maintain liquidity while earning rewards. With additional features like perpetuals, Aftermath serves as a primary gateway to Sui DeFi.
